//liveVersions: Null because com.goldkhatabook.app has never been published on either store.
These held SoneBill's live versions (iOS 1.0.15 build 10, Android versionCode 15),
inherited with the fork, so the Play versioning check failed this app's very first
build for not beating a release that belongs to a different product. The version
itself was deliberately reset to 1.0.0 / build 1; this is the record that was missed.
Both checks treat null as 'cannot verify' and warn instead of failing, which is the
honest state pre-launch. Fill them in after each real release - that is what turns
the warning back into a genuine guard against a reused versionCode.

allowedPermissionsNotes.android.permission.READ_CONTACTS: Customer picker imports a phone contact when creating an invoice or order. User-initiated, runtime-prompted.
allowedPermissionsNotes.android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN / _CON: Thermal receipt printer pairing and printing over BLE. The two legacy names are injected by rxandroidble for pre-Android-12 devices.
allowedPermissionsNotes.android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION: Required by Android for BLE scanning up to Android 11 only, hence maxSdkVersion=30 in the manifest. From Android 12 the app uses BLUETOOTH_SCAN with neverForLocation and never receives location.
allowedPermissionsNotes.android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE: Injected by React Native, Firebase and the biometrics library. Standard infrastructure, no user data.
allowedPermissionsNotes.com.google.android.finsky.permission.BIN: Injected by Play Services for install attribution.
allowedPermissionsNotes.com.goldkhatabook.app.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_N: AndroidX self-permission for the app's own runtime receivers. Not granted to any other app.
allowedPermissionsNotes._removed: Advertising permissions (AD_ID, ACCESS_ADSERVICES_*) are deliberately stripped with tools:node=remove in AndroidManifest.xml rather than allowlisted here — the app shows no ads and usesAds is false.

ignore.both.no-hardcoded-secrets: Both remaining matches are client-embedded keys that cannot be truly hidden in a shipped app bundle regardless of where they live in source: (1) src/config/firebaseWeb.ts's Firebase Web apiKey is Google's documented public client identifier — Firebase access control is enforced server-side by Security Rules, not by hiding this value (see the comment in that file); (2) src/config/secrets.ts's VITE_VC_API_KEY is a write-only Nexus telemetry-ingestion key (register device / log event / link device to an opaque user id) with no PII-read or destructive scope, moved to a gitignored file so it's at least out of git history. Full remediation for (2) requires proxying Nexus calls through gold-khata-book-backend using the user's own session instead of a shared static key — tracked as a follow-up, not done here.
